findings.summary: Author contribution suffix mapping is duplicated in the dialog instead of using the shared reader-author helper.
findings.consequence: Adding or changing a contribution role can leave reader sidebars and source-info dialogs rendering different suffixes, because the same editor/translator/illustrator/photographer mapping now has two owners.
findings.evidence: app/components/reader/ReaderSourceInfoDialog.vue line 89 defines local authorRole and lines 91-94 map editor/translator/illustrator/photographer to suffixes. shared/utils/reader-author.ts lines 8-23 already define readerAuthorContributionSuffix for the same domain concept, and app/components/reader/ReaderContributors.vue imports that helper.
findings.recommendation: Move the source-info-specific normalization for Swedish labels into shared/utils/reader-author.ts, or extend readerAuthorContributionSuffix to accept this source-info shape, then import the shared helper here.
